001: Shota, are you going to soccer club practice this Saturday?
Yeah, I'm planning to go. Yuki, why don't you come along too?
Sounds good. But I'm a bit worried since I haven't exercised much lately.
Don't worry. Everyone's a beginner, so feel free to join in.
I see. Well then, I'll look forward to it.
Yeah, I'll be waiting for you.
002: Hey, what kind of activities does the photography club do?
Once a month, we go out into town and take photos. We also share our work with each other.
Sounds interesting! Is it okay if I don't have a camera?
Yeah, a smartphone is fine at first. The senior members will teach you anyway.
Then it seems easy to get started.
Right. If you'd like, why don't you come check it out?
003: Kenta, is your club doing anything for the school festival?
Yeah, the drama club is putting on a play. I'm in charge of the lighting.
It was hard at first, but the senior members taught me, and I've gotten pretty used to it now.
That's impressive. I'm looking forward to the actual performance.
Thanks. Please come and watch it.
004: Yuki, I heard you joined the cooking club?
Yeah, I joined last month. We have activities every Wednesday.
What kind of food do you make?
Last week we made curry. Next time, we're going to try Japanese cuisine.
That sounds nice. Maybe I should go check it out too.
005: Hey, what are the volunteer club activities like?
We do community cleanup twice a month. We also hold events for kids.
Sounds fun, but will you have enough time?
Yeah, it's after classes, so it's not too much of a burden.
Then I'd like to join too.
Great. The next activity is next Sunday.
006: Takuya, I heard you play guitar in the band club?
Yeah, that's right. I'm going to perform in front of people for the first time at the upcoming live show.
I'm super nervous. But I've been practicing, so I think I'll be fine.
I'll cheer you on. Let me know the day of the live show.
Thanks. You absolutely have to come watch.
007: Misaki, what do you do in the English club?
Every Friday, we talk with a foreign instructor. We pick a theme and have a discussion.
Isn't it hard to speak in English?
It was hard at first, but everyone is kind, so I can speak without feeling nervous.
I see. I want to practice my English too, so I'd like to come check it out.
Sure. Want to come this Friday?
008: Hey, what kind of activities does the mountain climbing club do?
Once a month, we climb a nearby mountain. Sometimes we also go on expeditions.
Last year, we climbed Mount Fuji. It was really tough, but the view was amazing.
Mount Fuji, huh. I'd like to climb it someday too.
Then let's go together. Let's start by building up your stamina.
009: Daisuke, isn't the Go club a bit boring?
It might look boring, but it really makes you use your head.
Yeah. But the joy of winning is something special. Yuki, why don't you give it a try?
I wonder if I can do it. Could you teach me the rules?
Of course. There's also a workshop for beginners, so feel free to come by.
010: Hey, when is the dance club's recital?
It's on the fifteenth of next month at the gymnasium. We're practicing every day right now.
Every day, that's amazing. Aren't you tired?
I'm tired, but dancing with everyone is fun, so I can keep going.
I see. Well then, I'll look forward to the recital.
Yeah, I'll show you something cool.
